ic.definition: CUSTOMER increment, Jira ANAK-3 AC-01 to AC-06, implementation scope with a deterministic fake provider and synthetic data; no real provider call, no real data, no Brain write by the analyst path (seed writes only into the disposable vault of the real-parts suite). AC-01: in /world, Ana's office, the computer holds a text question panel backed by POST /api/world/analyst; every answer shows at least one post reference resolved server-side against the same snapshot (an answer without one is refused as no_evidence), separated measured, category, Brain and hypothesis blocks, fetch time and source status. Measured and category blocks hold no model free text: the model names {ref, metric or field}, the server renders value and label. Oracle: route tests against hand-computed fixture values, browser e2e (apps/dashboard/e2e/analyst.spec.ts) comparing shown measured values with /api/world; categories compared with a seeded world-post-tags.json including one record below TAG_MIN_CONFIDENCE. AC-02: isolated Anthropic, OpenAI and OpenRouter adapters, each with its own server-side key (WORLD_ANALYST_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, WORLD_ANALYST_OPENAI_API_KEY, WORLD_ANALYST_OPENROUTER_API_KEY; ANTHROPIC_API_KEY of the tagger is never read), selection only by WORLD_ANALYST_PROVIDER, URL, header, request, response and negative tests anchored to the provider docs named in the adapter with the date read; the selected provider is called exactly once, the others never; no fallback, no retry, no provider picker (OpenRouter sends provider.allow_fallbacks false); missing provider, key or model gives a recognisable error with no fetch. OpenAI and OpenRouter stay unproved against the real API, also after G4. AC-03: post facts hold only snapshot posts with insights_state ok or partial and VERIFIED values; the closed outbound field list is day, format, reach, views, saves, shares, total_interactions, er, ssr, theme, shot, hook, cta, mood (tags at or above TAG_MIN_CONFIDENCE; never country, brand, ana, confidence, exact time); null is never 0; group sizes and the time range are visible; unknown or wrongly typed refs are rejected; model prose exists only in the always labelled hypothesis block, where numbers not in the cited facts, quantities on the named word list of brief.ts, URLs, and audience or H1/H4 inference on a named word list are rejected and counted. The word lists do not prove that every claim is supported. AC-04: same access gate as the world routes: 401/403 without access, 415 on a wrong media type. Serialized outbound canaries prove no caption, image, permalink, handle, account id, media id, audience geography, follower count, person name, secret or provider error detail reaches the model. The body of POST /api/world/analyst holds no caption, permalink, handle, account id, geography, follower count, secret or provider error detail, and exactly the media ids of validated citations, no others. The provider sees per-request opaque refs. The question reaches the provider only when enabled, is at most 500 characters, is never stored or logged. Text of non-released notes reaches neither model nor browser: released notes under AC-06 are the only exception to AC-04's exclusion of Brain notes. AC-05: no diff in the paths listed in R2G (6); worker, provider, timeout and 429 failures give an honest message and no invented answer; a worker failure after an earlier good read gives an answer only with visible STALE status and the old fetch time; a failure before any good read refuses; nothing is stored or logged; no retries; one call at a time; a daily call cap; a disabled analyst makes no provider, worker or Brain call (route test), and the panel shows it (Playwright page.route). 390x844 without overflow, no serious or critical axe finding with the drawer open; the office focus trap includes the question field and skips disabled controls in both directions (named e2e); Escape keeps question and answer; a browser without WebGL reaches the panel from the world view without enabling WebGL for any part of the test. AC-06: a semantic Brain hit shows note id, source id, status, origin and uncertainty after readback through brain_get of note and source, repeated before output. Released only if the note id matches ^kn-world-pulse-\d{4}-w\d{2}$, status DERIVED, superseded_by null; created_by and all blocks agent:lumen; WORLD_ANALYST_BRAIN_SOURCES_<ACTIVE PROVIDER> names every cited source (a list for another provider releases nothing); each source is type source, created_by agent:lumen, superseded_by null, access internal or public, data_class G0 or G1; score at or above a floor calibrated and recorded on real BGE-M3. Only segments of the current block matching an exact grammar are released: Puls, Median aller Posts, Themen nach ER, Themen nach Save+Share, Marken-Posts with both groups at or above MIN_N, Nur Korrelation; every other segment, an allowed prefix with other content, topic notes, week briefs and other notes are withheld and leave the server only as a count. Limits: 3 notes, 600 characters per note, 1500 in total. Unset list, missing configuration, unindexed > 0, unreadable projection, Brain failure or unclear provenance give a visible BLOCKED or UNKNOWN state and no note text to the provider while the Instagram answer continues. Known limit put to the PO: a note grown since the last index run is not detected by the Dashboard; every Brain hit is labelled index state not proven and its text always comes from brain_get. The analyst holds a typed reader with only search(query, limit) and get(id), no generic call; a route test with a recording fetch proves only brain_search and brain_get with exact arguments, no include_retired. Identity rule: the Brain has no per-note ACL, so eligibility for the identity is the dashboard access gate (three identities) plus access not restricted; put to the PO. Tests: prompt-injection (injected text only inside the data fence, a scripted answer obeying it rejected; real model resistance not proved before G4), data-class, source, retired note and source, secret and context-budget canaries, oversized Brain answer. Real-parts suite apps/dashboard/src/server/analyst/analyst.real.test.ts on real Brain, Qdrant 1.19.2 and BGE-M3 with a synthetic seed and distractors, fresh process: paraphrase sharing no content word with the note ranks the right note first with the right source id, off-topic question releases 0 notes, same parser as production.

r2g.definition: On the exact candidate SHA with IC met: (1) GitHub Actions workflow 'dashboard' green on the exact PR head (npm ci, lint, typecheck, vitest, production build, client bundle scan, full Playwright e2e including e2e/analyst.spec.ts). (2) 'dashboard-image' green; a failure in the upload step stays a FAILURE and needs its own PO decision. (3) 'drs' green. (4) apps/dashboard/src/server/analyst/analyst.real.test.ts on that SHA with skipped = 0 and the passed count and measured scores recorded in the private evidence folder, because CI skips it. (5) Scoped mutation proof recorded: release boundary, per-provider list, retired check, segment grammar, ref check, number check, provider selection, typed reader, context limit: each guard removed once turns a named test red. (6) From the repository root, git diff --name-only <base> <candidate> -- apps/brain apps/dashboard/src/server/access.ts apps/dashboard/src/proxy.ts apps/dashboard/src/app/api/world/route.ts apps/dashboard/src/server/world apps/dashboard/src/features/world/pulse.ts apps/dashboard/src/features/world/postTags.ts apps/dashboard/src/server/social prints nothing, with one recorded canary run in which a test diff in a listed file trips it; e2e/world.spec.ts:213 keeps its exact tool set. No secret, no real Instagram or Brain content in the diff; mcpClient.ts byte-identical to PR #39 head b53c548. scan:bundle has name, shape, host and configured-value rules for the new keys and both provider hosts, each with a recorded canary, and dashboard.yml passes the fake value to the second scan. (7) DE, EN and IT keys complete by typecheck. Stale evidence (another SHA) is not evidence; a new commit invalidates R2G.

r4m.definition: The unchanged R2G candidate has: an independent acceptor outside the implementing session lineage (PO or separate reviewer session) that verified IC and R2G evidence on the exact candidate SHA with 0 open blocking findings; an independent semantic paraphrase authored outside the implementing lineage and run in a fresh session through analyst.real.test.ts (REAL_ANALYST_PARAPHRASE); before merge, a read-only match of a real Brain note and source id on the candidate's release rule under its own host-read approval with results in evidence-private, unless the PO decides that a synthetic seed on real parts satisfies 'autorisierter realer Brain-Seed'; the PR #39 reconciliation recorded (mcpClient.ts carried, block parsing ported, retrieval.ts and /api/brain/context stay there); PR targets main and is mergeable; exact readback immediately before the decision of base SHA, head SHA (= candidate), git merge-base --is-ancestor <base> <head> and the R2G check runs bound to the candidate; the PO decides merge separately. R4M is not merge authority and not a release. Merging does not arm egress, because WORLD_ANALYST_PROVIDER is unset on the host (re-measured before G4). Customer-Done needs separate G4 evidence bound to the delivered SHA with its relation to the candidate recorded (identical tree): per provider the data-subject consent, privacy, classification (post metrics, Haiku categories and theme aggregates, free question, Brain segments), provider, purpose and cost-limit approvals and WORLD_ANALYST_BRAIN_SOURCES_<PROVIDER>; release on Contabo; one real Anthropic call; an authenticated live browser test with a real snapshot.

scope_note: Brain-WRITE, chat persistence, new database, upload, audience and H1/H4 inference, historical single-post search through Brain digests (segment Neue Posts is withheld) and provider fallback are out of scope. mcpClient.ts is carried byte-identical from PR #39 head b53c548; its block parsing is ported; its writer, insight notes, retrieval.ts and /api/brain/context stay in PR #39. AC-04's exclusion of Brain notes is lifted only for notes released under AC-06 (PO decision of 2026-11-04, asked to be written into AC-04); audience geography, person and account data stay excluded for Brain content too. The analyst uses the write-capable agent key because no read scope exists: enforced client-side only by the typed reader, residual risk put to the PO.
